photos.title: Condo towers and beach houses on one block in North Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: The oceanfront in the City of North Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: a tan condo tower of about twelve stories and a taller grey glass tower stand on the same stretch as a three-story white condo building, a grey house and rows of raised houses on the streets behind, under oak trees. Dunes with boardwalks and the beach are in front. People on the beach are specks; no sign, plate or name is readable.
photos.caption: Condo towers and beach houses on the same oceanfront block in North Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: Two condo towers, a low condo building and raised beach houses side by side behind the dunes in North Myrtle Beach, seen from over the ocean

place.sublocation: Oceanfront in the City of North Myrtle Beach (Horry County tax district 550)

photos.title: The Surfside Beach pier and rows of raised beach houses, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: The oceanfront of the Town of Surfside Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: the wooden fishing pier runs out from the beach in the middle, with a parking lot and a mid-rise building to its left and close rows of raised two- and three-story beach houses to its right. Streets of houses and trees fill the background. People on the beach are specks; no sign, plate or name is readable.
photos.caption: The pier and rows of raised beach houses in Surfside Beach.
photos.alt: The Surfside Beach fishing pier with a parking lot on one side and rows of raised beach houses on the other, seen from over the ocean

place.sublocation: The pier and the oceanfront of the Town of Surfside Beach (Horry County tax district 660)

photos.title: The Garden City pier, condo buildings and houses on the strip between the ocean and the marsh, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Garden City Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: the end of the pier at the left edge, the beach road running back to a causeway over the salt marsh, shops and parking lots beside it, several mid-rise condo buildings and raised houses along the beach, and the marsh and creeks behind. photos.title: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: The oceanfront in the City of Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: three large towers of about twelve to fifteen stories with pools in front, a smaller building beside them, and streets of houses and low buildings under trees behind. The beach is crowded with umbrellas. People are specks; no sign, plate or name is readable.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach. Three in four condos in the city are in a zone marked for nightly rentals.
photos.alt: Three large oceanfront towers with pools in front of them in Myrtle Beach, and streets of houses behind, seen from over the ocean

place.sublocation: Oceanfront in the City of Myrtle Beach, north of the city center (Horry County tax district 880)

photos.title: A new subdivision going up in Longs, from above

photos.title: Waccamaw River Warehouse Historic District, June 2010
photos.what: A wooden boardwalk with a black metal rail runs past old wooden warehouses with tin roofs and a white building with a screened porch, under sycamore trees, in Conway's Waccamaw River Warehouse Historic District. A highway bridge shows through the trees at the upper left. One person walks far down the boardwalk, too small to recognise.
photos.caption: The riverwalk boardwalk past old wooden warehouses in downtown Conway.
photos.alt: A wooden boardwalk with a black rail running past old wooden warehouses and a building with a screened porch, under tall sycamore trees, in Conway

place.sublocation: Waccamaw River Warehouse Historic District, downtown Conway
